title_cn: 约翰·博泽拉表示，USMCA 是与中国竞争的关键“竞争力平台”
summary:
John Bozzella, president and CEO of Alliance for Automotive innovation, said that it is critical to have a trilateral trade agreement between the US, Canada and Mexico as a 'competitiveness platform' to compete with China in the automotive industry. Bozzella also discussed legislation to bar Chinese autos, saying that popular car company Mercedes would have to seek a waiver due to Chinese ownership stake. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Military Escorting Oil and Gas Through Strait, Wright Says
title_cn: 赖特说，美国军队护送石油和天然气通过海峡

Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that a new $100 billion data center campus built by NextEra energy and Brookfield will be powered by a nuclear and gas supply built on federal lands and will provide its own water. Wright also discussed the state of energy prices as the Iran war heats back up, and said it's not possible to forecast where gas prices will be by Labor Day. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: US refiners are turning crude oil into products like gasoline and diesel at a pace not seen since before the Covid-19 pandemic, but even that is unlikely to rein in soaring prices soon amid a historic fuel crunch.

summary: CoreWeave Inc. has sweetened terms on a $2.6 billion loan to fund additional computing capacity for firms including Anthropic PBC in an effort to win over investors growing wary of AI-related debt as bubble concerns mount.

title: Ford Shares Climb as Profit-Rich SUVs Drive Outlook Higher
title_cn: 利润丰厚的 SUV 推动前景走高，福特股价上涨
summary:
Ford Motor Co. raised its profit outlook for the second time this year as consumers continue to snap up the automaker’s high-margin sport-utility vehicles.
The rosier forecast, revealed late Tuesday as the automaker reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, shows how Ford is cashing in on resilient demand for SUVs and pickups, echoing a similar move by rival General Motors Co. last week.  Bloomberg's Craig Trudell joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DJI Debuts Long-Awaited Osmo 4P Camera, But US Creators Can’t Buy It
title_cn: 大疆发布期待已久的 Osmo 4P 相机，但美国创作者买不起
summary: Chinese drone maker DJI is rolling out its latest product, a mechanically stabilized camera, pressing ahead with global launches while its products remain locked out of the US market following a federal ban last year.

title: NextEra, Brookfield to Build $100 Billion Data Center Campus

summary: NextEra Energy Inc., the largest US power utility, is teaming up with Brookfield Corp. on a more than $100 billion transformation of a shuttered Cold War uranium-enrichment facility in Kentucky into a data center campus with a generating plant.

title: Why Moonshot's Kimi K3 Matters Beyond China
title_cn: 为什么 Moonshot 的 Kimi K3 在中国以外的地区也很重要
summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3 has reignited debate over China's role in the AI race, but Beringea Chief Investment Officer Karen McCormick says the bigger story is the growing availability of cheaper, open-weight AI models. She joins Bloomberg to explain why lower-cost AI is helping startups build faster, forcing frontier model providers to stay competitive, and accelerating AI adoption across industries. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SoFi Doubles Down on AI Despite Market Pullback
title_cn: 尽管市场回落，SoFi仍加倍押注人工智能
summary: SoFi posted record quarterly revenue and raised its full-year sales outlook. SoFi CEO Anthony Noto discusses why the company is keeping its earnings guidance unchanged, how AI is boosting engineering productivity and customer service, and why SoFi is continuing to invest for long-term growth despite shifting expectations for interest rates. Noto joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Creator of Test That OpenAI Models Tried to Cheat Sounds Alarm
title_cn: OpenAI 模型试图作弊的测试创建者敲响了警钟
summary: A group of university researchers that developed benchmarks to test the cybersecurity capabilities of AI systems have unexpectedly landed themselves at the center of OpenAI’s accidental hack into the startup Hugging Face Inc.

title: AI Workers Call for US to Pace Tech's Growth
title_cn: 人工智能工作者呼吁美国加快科技发展步伐
summary: More than 1,100 workers from top AI firms have signed a petition calling on the US government to help "deliberately pace" AI development. The letter's signatories include the CEO of Anthropic and the chief scientists from OpenAI and Meta Superintelligence Lab. Bloomberg's AI editor Seth Fiegerman joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Altman Discusses ‘Need to Pace’ AI Development With White House
title_cn: 奥特曼与白宫讨论“需要加快”人工智能发展的步伐
summary: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman said he supports slowing the pace of artificial intelligence development, highlighting the company’s shifting approach to the emerging technology after one of its advanced AI models inadvertently hacked Hugging Face Inc. last week.

title: SK Hynix Slips Ahead of Big Tech Results | Bloomberg Tech 7/29/2026
title_cn: SK 海力士领先于大型科技公司业绩 |彭博科技 2026 年 7 月 29 日
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down why SK Hynix's Korean shares slumped even after reporting a six-fold jump in profit and raised capital spending to a record $31 billion. Plus, SoFi CEO Anthony Noto joins following the company's earnings topping Wall Street estimates, but showing high expenses; and big tech earnings are on the docket, with Microsoft and Meta coming next. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Model Escape, Then Target Tools to Help Themselves Improve
title_cn: AI 模型逃脱，然后瞄准工具来帮助自己改进
summary: Goal-driven behavior, not malicious intent, is a key problem, according to security experts.

title: Stonepeak's Dorrell on AI, Data Centers, Infrastructure
title_cn: Stonepeak 的 Dorrell 谈人工智能、数据中心、基础设施
summary: Stonepeak Chairman, CEO and co-founder Michael Dorrell talks about opportunities in markets, the growth of artificial intelligence, demand for new data centers and how it all plays into their investment strategy on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Microsoft, Meta Earnings Face a Market Growing Skeptical of AI
title_cn: 微软、元收益面临市场对人工智能日益怀疑的局面
summary: Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc. are about to test investors’ diminishing patience for Big Tech’s profligate spending on artificial intelligence and the dwindling cash positions that are the result of it.

title: Microsoft, Meta Earnings Take Center Stage | Open Interest 7/29/2026
title_cn: 微软，元收益成为焦点 |未平仓合约 7/29/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Tech takes center stage as investors await blockbuster results from Microsoft and Meta. Oil surges after President Trump threatens new strikes on Iran, putting markets on edge. Plus, will the Federal Reserve stand pat or deliver a surprise. We'll break it all down with Goldman Sachs' David Mericle, Battery Ventures' Dharmesh Thakker on AI's next winners, and Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber joins us on chip risks, holiday demand, and navigating supply chain pressure. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: FTC Split Lets IonQ-SkyWater Quantum Deal Close Without Changes
title_cn: FTC 分拆让 IonQ 与 SkyWater Quantum 交易无需任何变更即可完成
summary: IonQ Inc. will close its $1.8 billion acquisition of semiconductor foundry SkyWater Technology Inc. later this week after the Federal Trade Commission was unable to decide whether to impose conditions on the deal, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Experts Warn SpaceX Starship Heat Shield May Delay Rapid Flight Plans
title_cn: 专家警告 SpaceX 星舰隔热罩可能会延迟快速飞行计划
summary: The heat shield that protects SpaceX’s Starship vehicle as it plummets back to Earth may prove to be a substantial roadblock to Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk’s path to designing a rapidly reusable rocket, according to three former NASA researchers and experts in the field.

title: Enterprise AI's Biggest Opportunity
title_cn: 企业人工智能的最大机遇
summary: Battery Ventures General Partner Dharmesh Thakker joins Bloomberg Open Interest to make the case for investing beyond AI hype. He explains why enterprise software companies that deliver measurable business value will outperform. He also argues that open-source AI models could slash enterprise costs, accelerate adoption, and reshape the competitive landscape for OpenAI, Anthropic, and the broader AI ecosystem. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Logitech CEO Faber Says Chip Supply Is Unusually Tight
title_cn: 罗技首席执行官 Faber 表示芯片供应异常紧张
summary: Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber discusses the company’s first-quarter results and the impact of a late-June incident at a key semiconductor supplier. Speaking with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Faber also discusses gaming demand, component costs and the company's pricing strategy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Software Woes Push Europe Lenders to Seek Rare Repayment Terms
title_cn: 软件困境迫使欧洲贷款机构寻求罕见的还款条件
summary: Lenders are so worried about the impact of artificial intelligence on software firms that they’re pushing for repayment terms rarely seen in Europe since the global financial crisis.

title: US Risks Broadening China Clash With Robot, Inverter Curbs
title_cn: 美国对机器人、逆变器的限制可能导致中国与美国的冲突扩大
summary: Washington tightened curbs on some foreign-made robots and inverters, vital components of solar-powered electricity, in a sweeping move that risks widening its tech confrontation with Beijing less than two months before a meeting between the countries’ leaders.

title: AI Spending In Focus for Meta, Microsoft Earnings
title_cn: 人工智能支出成为 Meta 和微软盈利的焦点
summary: Gil Luria of DA Davidson says Microsoft will be the key company to watch during this earnings season and it all has to do with spending on artificial intelligence and capex. Microsoft and Meta Platforms both report after the bell on Wednesday. Luria speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Will AI Consume Investors' Risk Budget?
title_cn: 人工智能会消耗投资者的风险预算吗？
summary: Jason Thomas, head of global research and investment strategy at Carlyle, discusses whether AI investment is crowding out other opportunities as capital flows into AI infrastructure. He examines market concentration, portfolio allocation and the outlook for corporate spending, asking whether AI is "going to consume almost the entirety, or certainly a large portion, of their incremental risk budget over the next three to five years?" This interview aired July 28. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Says US Will Strike Iran Hard as War Escalates Again
title_cn: 特朗普表示，随着战争再次升级，美国将严厉打击伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump said the US would strike back at Iran after a recent attack that targeted a military base in Jordan, as the war in the Middle East flared up again following a pause in hostilities.

title: Warsh Says There Was Much Agreement on Hard Questions
title_cn: 沃什表示，在难题上达成了很多共识
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says there was much agreement among policymakers when it came to hard questions.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed's Warsh Says There Is No Soft Inflation Target
title_cn: 美联储沃什表示没有软通胀目标
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says the fight to bring down inflation has just begun. “Let me reiterate: there is no soft inflation target, there is no soft implicit target, not on this committee’s watch," he said during a press conference in Washington. Warsh says "there's only a target, and it's 2%." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Seeks Supreme Court Review to Revive Dismissed Clinton Lawsuit
title_cn: 特朗普寻求最高法院复审以恢复被驳回的克林顿诉讼
summary: President Donald Trump said he will ask the US Supreme Court to revive his failed lawsuit accusing Hillary Clinton, the Democratic National Committee and others of conspiring to tarnish his 2016 campaign with bogus claims of collusion with Russia.

title: Saudi Attack on Iraq: Who are the Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF)?
title_cn: 沙特袭击伊拉克：谁是人民动员力量（PMF）？
summary: A new line of fighting in the war in the Middle East opened up on July 28 when Saudi Arabia launched an attack on Iraq, with which the kingdom has generally cordial relations. The strike, carried out in conjunction with US forces, targeted Iranian-backed militants in Iraq who, the Saudis said, had fired drones at Saudi oil facilities two days in a row.

title: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Three Dissenters Wanted a Hike
title_cn: 美联储维持利率稳定，三名反对者希望加息
summary: The Federal Reserve voted to hold interest rates unchanged in a range of 3.5% to 3.75%, with some officials dissenting in favor of raising rates by a quarter percentage point. The vote was 9-3. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: NextEra, Brookfield Plan $100B Hub | Balance of Power 7/29/2026
title_cn: NextEra，Brookfield 计划 $100B 中心 |权力平衡 7/29/2026

On today's show, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and American Principles Project Political Director Katie Frost. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mamdani Stands by Pied-à-Terre Rollout Despite Backlash

summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani defended the rollout of a new tax on highly valued second homes in New York City, saying only property owners who receive a letter from city officials will be impacted by the levy.

summary: Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right to not testify at a Senate committee hearing on his role in the US response to Covid-19 after slamming the proceeding as having been designed to push him into making incriminating statements.

title: Trump Asks Supreme Court to Toss $83 Million Carroll Verdict

title: US Sanctions Iran’s ‘Extortion Network’ Over Hormuz Tolls

summary: The US imposed sanctions on two Iranian companies that charge for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, an attempt to loosen Tehran’s grip on the vital waterway as hostilities between the countries resume.

title: Cornyn Cancels Blanche Meeting Ahead of Pivotal Committee Vote
title_cn: 科宁在关键委员会投票前取消布兰奇会议
summary: Republican Senator John Cornyn abruptly canceled a meeting Wednesday with President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Justice Department, throwing into doubt a planned Thursday committee vote on the nomination.

title: Cyprus Leaders Accept UN Plan for Talks Over Divided Island

title: Fauci Invokes Fifth Amendment at Senate Covid Hearing

summary: Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right to not testify at a Senate committee hearing on his role in the US response to Covid-19 after slamming the proceeding as having been designed to push him into making incriminating statements. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US-Iran Conflict Likely to Continue for Months With Hormuz Talks Stalled

summary: The US’s conflict against Iran looks set to drag on, possibly for months, with the sides unable to break a deadlock over the Strait of Hormuz and achieve a lasting ceasefire deal, according to several current and former officials from the US, Iran and Europe.

title: Trump Says Iran Will 'Get a Beating' for Targeting Base in Jordan
title_cn: 特朗普称伊朗将因袭击约旦基地而“遭受打击”
summary: President Donald Trump says Iran will get hit hard after it targeted a US base in Jordan. Those missiles were intercepted. Trump told Fox News that Iran will "get a beating." The US and Saudi Arabia also have struck militants backed by Tehran in Iraq. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Burnham Signals Tax Rises Needed to Fix UK Social Care
title_cn: 伯纳姆表示需要提高税收来解决英国的社会保障问题
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham indicated tax rises will likely be needed to pay for a major new social care policy, launching a nine-month “national conversation” about an issue he vowed to resolve after failed government attempts going back three decades.

title: Fauci Pleads Fifth Amendment at Senate Covid-19 Hearing
title_cn: 福奇在参议院 Covid-19 听证会上为第五修正案辩护
summary: Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment rights and declined to testify Wednesday in a Senate committee hearing on his role in the US response to Covid-19. Fauci slammed the proceeding as having been designed to push him into making incriminating statements. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Expected to Hold Rates, But Warsh Could Shock the Street
title_cn: 美联储预计将维持利率不变，但沃什可能会震惊华尔街
summary: The Fed is expected to hold interest rates steady when it concludes its two-day meeting today. But Wall Street still says there's a 35% chance Chairman Kevin Warsh could shock markets and hike rates. Bloomberg's Michael McKee has more on what to watch for. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Kenya Orders Africa’s Top Soda-Ash Producer to Halt Operations
title_cn: 肯尼亚命令非洲最大的纯碱生产商停止运营
summary: Kenya’s government ordered Africa’s largest soda-ash producer to suspend operations, citing its failure to make royalty payments and meet other regulatory requirements.
